title: Смертельный вобблинг мотоцикла на трассе при 130 км/ч
hook: Твой руль внезапно начинает агрессивно биться из стороны в сторону на огромной скорости. Сделай это, иначе ты разобьешься!

steps.line: Твой руль внезапно начинает агрессивно биться из стороны в сторону на огромной скорости. Одно инстинктивное движение убьет тебя — запоминай алгоритм спасения!
steps.imagePrompt: Hyper-realistic cinematic photography, 8K, dramatic lighting, intense atmosphere. SCENE: First-person perspective looking over a motorcycle dashboard going at high speeds, blurred highway background. PERSON: Rider wearing dark protective leather jacket and helmet, hands blurred in motion holding violently shaking motorcycle handlebars (tank slapper effect). ENVIRONMENT: Empty daytime highway asphalt racing by, speed lines blur reflecting immense velocity. CAMERA: First-person POV, eye-level, vertical 9:16 format. MOOD: High tension, life-or-death urgency, survival documentary style. LIGHTING: Harsh afternoon sun, high contrast reflections on the tank, cinematic color grading. DETAILS: Scratched leather gloves, digital speedometer showing 130 km/h, intense visible motion blur on the front wheel. QUALITY: Award-winning photojournalism, ultra-detailed, sharp focus on the dashboard while periphery is blurred.
steps.videoPrompt: CAMERA MOVEMENT: Intense first-person tracking shot mounted on the chest, realistic violent camera shake simulating handlebar vibrations. ACTION: The motorcycle handlebars suddenly start violently shaking left and right (tank slapper). The rider's gloved hands attempt to hold on as the bike destabilizes. MOTION: Rapid, erratic vibration of the steering column, high-speed road surface blurring past. ENVIRONMENT: Fast-moving highway asphalt, desolate surroundings. PACING: Fast-paced survival action, extreme high tension, documentary realism. ENDING: Freeze on the terrifying rapid oscillation of the gauges. QUALITY: Cinematic 8K, natural motion, realistic physics, survival documentary style.

steps.line: Шаг 1: Ни в коем случае не жми на тормоза! Торможение загрузит переднее колесо и моментально выбросит тебя из седла.
steps.imagePrompt: Hyper-realistic cinematic photography, 8K, dramatic lighting, intense atmosphere. SCENE: Close-up of a rider's right hand hovering strictly away from the motorcycle's front brake lever while the bike shakes. PERSON: Motorcyclist in torn leather jacket, tense posture, physically resisting the urge to grab the brake. ENVIRONMENT: Highway asphalt rushing below in a heavy blur. CAMERA: Close-up macro shot, specifically angled on the handle and brake lever, vertical 9:16 format. MOOD: Extreme tension, life-or-death urgency, survival documentary style. LIGHTING: Overcast dramatic natural lighting, high contrast, cinematic color grading. DETAILS: Knuckles tense inside heavy-duty Kevlar gloves, authentic survival gear, exact mechanical details of the brake master cylinder. QUALITY: Award-winning photojournalism, National Geographic style, ultra-detailed, sharp focus on the brake lever and open hand.
steps.videoPrompt: CAMERA MOVEMENT: Smooth handheld tracking shot zoomed in on the right handlebar, slight camera shake for realism. ACTION: The rider's right hand consciously opens up, fingers explicitly pulling away from the metallic brake lever while the bike vibrates beneath them. MOTION: Realistic human movement, urgency in body language, fingers maintaining tension but refusing to squeeze. ENVIRONMENT: Blurring highway lines denoting extreme speed. PACING: Fast-paced survival action, high tension, documentary realism. ENDING: Freeze on the straight, open fingers avoiding the brake. QUALITY: Cinematic 8K, natural motion, realistic physics, survival documentary style.

steps.line: Шаг 2: Ослабь хватку на руле. Не пытайся бороться с колебаниями силой — твои жесткие руки только передают вибрацию на весь кузов.
steps.imagePrompt: Hyper-realistic cinematic photography, 8K, dramatic lighting, intense atmosphere. SCENE: The rider visibly relaxing their grip on the violently shaking handlebars, hands floating slightly loose on the grips. PERSON: Focused rider, upper body posture shifts from rigid to flexible, shoulders dropped to absorb physical shock. ENVIRONMENT: Highway barriers blurring past rapidly. CAMERA: Medium shot from the side of the motorcycle, eye-level, vertical 9:16 format. MOOD: High tension, life-or-death urgency, survival documentary style. LIGHTING: Golden hour lighting casting long dynamic shadows, high contrast, cinematic color grading. DETAILS: Authentic survival riding gear, loose open grip on the rubber handles, front wheel shown in a violent chaotic blur. QUALITY: Award-winning photojournalism, National Geographic style, ultra-detailed, sharp focus on the relaxed arms and posture.
steps.videoPrompt: CAMERA MOVEMENT: Smooth handheld tracking shot alongside the motorcycle, following the person's upper body, slight camera shake for realism. ACTION: The rider intentionally softens their hand grip, letting their arms act as shock absorbers instead of rigidly fighting the violent shaking of the heavy handlebars. MOTION: Fluid elbow movement absorbing rapid mechanical vibrations, displaying control through sudden physical relaxation. ENVIRONMENT: Highway barriers whizzing past rapidly. PACING: Fast-paced survival action, high tension, documentary realism. ENDING: Freeze on the rider's bent elbows acting as flexible suspension. QUALITY: Cinematic 8K, natural motion, realistic physics, survival documentary style.

steps.line: Шаг 3: Максимально сильно сожми бензобак коленями. Это сместит центр тяжести вниз, стабилизирует мотоцикл и вернет тебе контроль над несущимся байком.
steps.imagePrompt: Hyper-realistic cinematic photography, 8K, dramatic lighting, intense atmosphere. SCENE: Close focus on the rider's legs clad in reinforced riding jeans aggressively squeezing the motorcycle's metal gas tank. PERSON: Lower body of the rider, thigh muscles clearly tensed and locked tightly onto the side of the fuel tank. ENVIRONMENT: Speeding along a coastal highway, road line blurring heavily. CAMERA: Medium-low angle shot focusing strictly on the tank and knees, vertical 9:16 format. MOOD: High tension, mechanical survival instinct, physical strain. LIGHTING: Dramatic natural lighting, high contrast shadows, cinematic color grading. DETAILS: Creases in heavy Kevlar denim, deep scuff marks on the rubber tank pads, authentic riding boots securely locked into metal footpegs. QUALITY: Award-winning photojournalism, National Geographic style, ultra-detailed, sharp focus on the gripped knees.
steps.videoPrompt: CAMERA MOVEMENT: Smooth low-angle handheld tracking shot, following the rider's lower half, slight camera vibration mimicking extreme speed. ACTION: The motorcyclist forcefully clamps both knees inward against the fuel tank, locking their lower body rigidly to stabilize the shaking heavy machine. MOTION: Sudden, powerful muscular contraction, effectively locking the rider's mass to the bike's center of gravity. ENVIRONMENT: High-speed road textures and asphalt cracks flying underneath the frame. PACING: Fast-paced survival action, high tension, documentary realism. ENDING: Freeze on the locked, determined leg posture physically gripping the bike. QUALITY: Cinematic 8K, natural motion, realistic physics, survival documentary style.

steps.line: Шаг 4: Наклонись вперед над баком и плавно закрой газ. Аэродинамика поможет снизить скорость, а вес тела нагрузит переднюю вилку правильно.
steps.imagePrompt: Hyper-realistic cinematic photography, 8K, dramatic lighting, intense atmosphere. SCENE: Rider leaning chest-down flat onto the motorcycle tank, lowering their center of gravity while the right hand gently rotates the throttle closed. PERSON: Highly focused rider, helmet tucked down securely behind the acrylic windshield, aerodynamic survival posture. ENVIRONMENT: Fast open highway, wind distortion visually implied by extreme motion blur behind the subject. CAMERA: Medium shot from a slight front-angle profile, vertical 9:16 format. MOOD: Intense concentration, life-or-death survival rescue, adrenaline rush. LIGHTING: Dramatic natural lighting, sunlight flaring beautifully over the edge of the helmet, high contrast. DETAILS: Vents on the dark visor, bugs splattered on the windshield, authentic leather riding gear, specific exact hand gesture closing the throttle. QUALITY: Award-winning photojournalism, National Geographic style, ultra-detailed, crisp focus.
steps.videoPrompt: CAMERA MOVEMENT: Smooth handheld tracking shot from an adjacent perspective matching vehicle speed, slight camera shake for realism. ACTION: The rider drops their chest flat against the metal fuel tank to dramatically low their body weight forward, while the right wrist smoothly rotates forward to cut engine power without touching any brakes. MOTION: Swift, calculated aerodynamic crouch, precise and exceptionally gentle throttle roll-off. ENVIRONMENT: Scenery initially blurring fast but visibly beginning to slow down as speed scrubs off. PACING: Fast-paced survival action transitioning slowly into mechanical control. ENDING: Freeze on the streamlined, heavily crouched rider silhouette. QUALITY: Cinematic 8K, natural motion, realistic physics, survival documentary style.

steps.line: Шаг 5: Дождись прекращения вобблинга и плавно съезжай на обочину. Сохрани это видео прямо сейчас — однажды эта инструкция спасет твою жизнь.
steps.imagePrompt: Hyper-realistic cinematic photography, 8K, dramatic lighting, intense atmosphere. SCENE: The motorcycle, now completely riding straight and stable, gently pulling over onto the dusty gravel shoulder of the highway. PERSON: Rider sitting upright, deeply exhaling in extreme relief, helmet visor flipped fully open showing a dirty, sweat-covered, visibly relieved face. ENVIRONMENT: Quiet highway shoulder setting, loose gravel and dust kicking up slightly under the stabilized rear tire. CAMERA: Medium portrait shot, eye-level, vertical 9:16 format. MOOD: Immense relief, survival documentary aftermath, exhaustion and triumph. LIGHTING: Dramatic warm golden hour sunset lighting, deep cinematic color grading. DETAILS: Visible heavy sweat drops on the forehead, thick dust on the leather jacket, motorcycle completely stopped safely, authentic tire marks perfectly visible on the gravel. QUALITY: Award-winning photojournalism, National Geographic style, ultra-detailed, sharp focus on facial expression.
steps.videoPrompt: CAMERA MOVEMENT: Smooth handheld tracking walking shot circling around to the front of the stopped motorcycle, slight camera sway for a gritty documentary feel. ACTION: The motorcycle stabilizes completely and smoothly pulls onto the roadside shoulder. The rider comes to a safe stop, violently kicks the metal kickstand down, throws open the helmet visor, and takes a massive, exhausted deep breath of survival relief. MOTION: Slowing down from extreme speed to a complete rigid stop, heavy exhausted chest breathing. ENVIRONMENT: Dusty roadside shoulder, blurry cars safely passing far in the background. PACING: Decelerating pacing, immense emotional relief, stark documentary realism. ENDING: Freeze exactly on the rider's intense, determined, and relieved face looking directly into the camera. QUALITY: Cinematic 8K, natural motion, realistic physics, survival documentary style.
